events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Tutorial: Rout

options.text: I will set up my Mounted Melee Units to chain kills together using Rout!

events.text: Your [unit] has just killed an enemy Unit, but because it has the Rout ability, it can keep attacking. Units that can Rout will move into an enemy's Tile upon destroying them, allowing them to attack again this Turn as long as there is another enemy Unit adjacent to their new location. Generally, only Mounted Melee Units like Horseman and Chariot can perform a Rout. If well placed, this can permit Units like your [unit] to chain together multiple kills in a single Turn.
